Zameen o aasmaan ka har zarra us Khuda ki tasbeeh kar raha hai jo baadshaah, paakeeza sifaat aur saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Us Khuda ne Makka waalon mein ek rasool bheja hai jo unhi mein se tha ke un ke saamne aayaat ki tilaawat kare, un ke nufoos ko paakeeza banaaye aur inhein kitaab o hikmat ki ta'leem de, agarche yeh log badi khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala the
Aur un mein se un logon ki taraf bhi jo abhi un se mulhaq nahin hue hain, aur woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi
Yeh ek fazl-e-Khuda hai, woh jise chaahta hai ata kar deta hai, aur woh bade azeem fazl ka maalik hai

Un logon ki misaal jin par Tauraat ka baar rakha gaya aur woh use utha na sake, us gadhe ki misaal hai jo kitaabon ka bojh uthaaye hue ho. Yeh badtareen misaal un logon ki hai jinhon ne aayaat-e-Ilaahi ki takzeeb ki hai, aur Khuda kisi zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai
Aap keh dijiye ke Yahoodiyo! Agar tumhaara khayaal yeh hai ke tamaam insaanon mein tum hi Allah ke dost ho, to agar apne da'we mein sachche ho to maut ki tamanna karo
Aur yeh hargiz maut ki tamanna nahin karenge ke un ke haathon ne pehle bahut kuch kar rakha hai, aur Allah zaalimeen ke haalaat ko khoob jaanta hai

Aap keh dijiye ke tum jis maut se faraar kar rahe ho woh khud tum se mulaaqaat karne waali hai. Us ke baad tum us ki baargaah mein palataaye jaaoge jo haazir o ghaaib sab ka jaanne waala hai, aur woh tumhein baakhabar karega ke tum daar-e-duniya mein kya kar rahe the
Imaan waalo! Jab tumhein Juma ke din namaaz ke liye pukaara jaaye to zikr-e-Khuda ki taraf daud pado aur kaarobaar band kar do, ke yahi tumhaare haq mein behtar hai agar tum jaanne waale ho
Phir jab namaaz tamaam ho jaaye to zameen mein muntashir ho jaao aur fazl-e-Khuda ko talaash karo, aur Khuda ko bahut yaad karo ke shaayad isi tarah tumhein najaat haasil ho jaaye

Aur aye Paighambar! Yeh log jab tijaarat ya lahw o la'b ko dekhte hain to us ki taraf daud padte hain aur aap ko tanha khada chhod dete hain. Aap un se keh dijiye ke Khuda ke paas jo kuch bhi hai woh is khel aur tijaarat se bahar-haal behtar hai, aur woh behtareen rizq dene waala hai
